data.long_meaning: The name Yayivansh is derived from the Sanskrit language and is a combination of two words – Yaji (God) and Van (descendant). The name signifies a God's descendant or a divine being. It is a powerful and auspicious name bestowed upon children born in Hindu families. The name Yayivansh carries the meaning “God's descendant” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit. Parents who choose Yayivansh usually hope their child will grow to embody god's descendant and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Yayivansh total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

historical_references.reference: The name 'Yayivansh' is derived from 'Yadavansh', the lineage of the Yadavas. The term 'Yayi' is an honorific title given to the eldest male member of the clan.
historical_references.context: In Hindu mythology, the Yadavas are considered to be the descendants of Lord Krishna through his brother, Balarama.
